readings: Considering every playlist in `Playlist`, including those with no entries in `PlaylistTrack` (which count as zero), count each playlist's track entries and work out the average of these counts across all of these playlists. For the 10 playlists with the highest ratio of track count to that average, show the playlist id, its track count and the ratio (count ÷ average, unrounded), sorted by the ratio from highest to lowest with any missing ratios last.
queries:
WITH playlist_counts AS (
    SELECT p.PlaylistId, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS track_count
    FROM Playlist AS p
    LEFT JOIN PlaylistTrack AS pt ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId
    GROUP BY p.PlaylistId
),
average_count AS (
    SELECT AVG(track_count) AS avg_count
    FROM playlist_counts
)
SELECT
    pc.PlaylistId,
    pc.track_count,
    pc.track_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(ac.avg_count, 0) AS ratio
FROM playlist_counts AS pc
CROSS JOIN average_count AS ac
ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
